assessment.nobel_worthiness: A foundational body of political-economy research linking political institutions, state capacity, electoral incentives and fiscal outcomes.
assessment.attribution: These three are central and complementary contributors to the core theoretical and empirical agenda.
assessment.maturity: The work has shaped research and policy analysis over several decades.
uncertainties: The breadth of the agenda makes the most coherent citation boundary difficult to specify.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Population administrative data transformed measurement of intergenerational mobility and made geographic inequality of opportunity salient and policy-relevant.
assessment.attribution: Chetty, Hendren and Friedman are especially closely associated with the defining empirical program.
assessment.maturity: Findings and methods have diffused widely, with extensive replication and follow-on work.
uncertainties: Causal implications for mobility policy remain more contested than the descriptive measurement advances.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Correspondence studies supplied unusually direct and influential evidence on discrimination in labour markets.
assessment.attribution: Bertrand and Mullainathan's landmark audit design is a clear centerpiece of this contribution.
assessment.maturity: The approach has been applied broadly across countries and markets and remains highly consequential.
uncertainties: Audit outcomes identify responses at the application stage rather than the full structure of labour-market discrimination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The reconstruction of long-run income and wealth distributions reshaped research and public understanding of inequality.
assessment.attribution: Piketty, Saez and Zucman are leading architects of the data, measurement and offshore-wealth components.
assessment.maturity: The research program has had sustained scholarly influence and generated large international data infrastructure.
uncertainties: Some estimates depend on strong capitalization, valuation and tax-data assumptions.
The appropriate balance between measurement innovation and substantive causal explanation is debatable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Partial identification supplied a rigorous alternative to unwarranted point identification and strengthened credible empirical inference.
assessment.attribution: Manski established the central framework, with Tamer and Molinari making major advances in moment inequalities and implementation.
assessment.maturity: The ideas are deeply embedded in modern econometric practice and applied work.
uncertainties: The contribution may be perceived as more methodological than directly visible outside econometrics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Theory and measurement of adverse selection have made insurance markets a model case for connecting information economics to credible evidence.
assessment.attribution: Finkelstein, Einav and Salanie have each made central contributions to the modern empirical analysis of selection.
assessment.maturity: The framework has influenced health, credit, insurance and contract research for many years.
uncertainties: The evidence on the prevalence and welfare importance of adverse selection varies substantially by market.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: This work clarified how technology and trade shocks alter local labour markets, occupational tasks and inequality.
assessment.attribution: Autor, Dorn and Hanson are the principal contributors to the influential China-shock and task-based empirical literature.
assessment.maturity: The findings have been heavily studied and have strongly affected trade and labour-policy debates.
uncertainties: Estimated local effects and extrapolation to aggregate welfare remain subject to active methodological debate.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Their work brought exhaustible resources, natural capital and biodiversity into rigorous long-run economic analysis.
assessment.attribution: Dasgupta and Heal are both foundational contributors to the relevant theory of resource use and welfare.
assessment.maturity: The ideas have longstanding intellectual influence and growing relevance for environmental accounting and policy.
uncertainties: Translating inclusive-wealth concepts into policy-ready measurement remains difficult.
